wikitext: {{VolumePrevNext |number=63 |series=Pokémon Adventures |colorscheme=ORAS |last=no }} {{VolumeInfobox |image=Pokémon Adventures VIZ volume 63.jpg |number=63 |series=Pokémon Adventures |chapters=[[PS602]] - [[PS609]] |chapter=ORAS }} '''Volume 63''' is the 63rd volume of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is the second volume of the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. ==Blurb== Under orders from Joseph Stone, president of the Devon Corporation, the nefarious Pokémon energy absorption plan continues to move forward. Already filled with unease, Sapphire and Emerald are inexplicably attacked by Zinnia, another Trainer.
